exifStrip.idle: সরা হয়েছে: GPS, ক্যাপচার সময়, ক্যামেরা এবং ডিভাইস তথ্য, এমবেডেড থাম্বনেইল, সম্পাদনা ইতিহাস। রাখা হয়েছে: orientation, colour profile, dimensions, pixel data।
exifStrip.note: শুধুমাত্র স্থির ছবি। ভিডিও, PDF, HEIC, AVIF এবং GIF এর ক্ষেত্রে প্রযোজ্য নয় এবং C2PA provenance manifests অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

validate.luhnCaveat: Luhn pass only checks digit structure — not that the card exists or has funds.

dns.name: Name / host
dns.note: Resolved by the Forge host DNS resolver — may differ from your local stub or browser DoH.

tls.note: Connects from the Forge host. Inspection disables trust rejection so you can still read an untrusted leaf.

myIp.note: Shows how this request reached Forge. No ASN/geo without a licensed data feed.

mermaid.note: Official mermaid 11 (securityLevel=strict). Live client preview · Agent SVG via Playwright. Not a DBML ERD product.

colorDeltaE.note: CIEDE2000 via culori. Thresholds are UI review heuristics, not print contracts. color-convert already covers OKLCH.

dbml.parseNote: Hard-correct: parse & inventory only. Visual ERD ships only when layout quality passes the ship gate.
dbml.convertNote: @dbml/core ModelExporter / importer — same path as the API.

dnsLeak.probeHostHint: Only used for multi-resolver / browser DoH A-record comparison — not your leak probe names.
dnsLeak.idle: Start a check to compare multi-resolver paths, browser DoH, and WebRTC candidates.
dnsLeak.idleOnline: Authority zone is online. One click captures your system-DNS recursive resolvers, then DoH / WebRTC for comparison.
dnsLeak.note: Full OS-system DNS leak maps need an authoritative leak zone. Forge never invents Geo/ASN.
dnsLeak.noteOnline: Unique probe names under leak.nebutra.com reveal which recursive resolvers query on your OS DNS path.
dnsLeak.forgeNote: These queries leave from the Forge host — not your laptop.
dnsLeak.egressNote: What OpenDNS/Google see for the Forge host egress, not your device.
dnsLeak.verdictConsistent: Paths look consistent on this check
dnsLeak.verdictIpMismatch: WebRTC public IP differs from edge IP
dnsLeak.authorityNote: IPs that queried your unique probe names (OS system DNS path). Compare with VPN/DNS provider.
dnsLeak.authorityNoHits: No recursive hits this round. Try disabling browser Secure DNS, then run again.
dnsLeak.authorityOfflineHint: Authority zone is offline — system-DNS capture unavailable.
